aboutMe.name: Jiří Rakučák
aboutMe.role: Frontend-focused creative developer building DevOS-style web experiences.
aboutMe.summary: I like portfolio work that behaves like a product: structured content, thoughtful interaction, and enough technical depth to show how it was built.

focus.title: Current focus
focus.body: This portfolio is becoming a bilingual React/Vite experience with a desktop-inspired DevOS layer, centralized content, and service pages that can later connect to an admin workflow.

build.title: What I build
build.body: Frontend systems, interactive 3D concepts, content-driven portfolio surfaces, and pragmatic backend foundations when the product actually needs them.

work.title: How I work
work.body: I prefer clear structure, small focused components, practical technology choices, and visible polish over decorative complexity.

react.label: React
react.description: Primary UI layer for this portfolio and most current frontend work.

typescript.label: TypeScript
typescript.description: Keeps content models, routes, and UI contracts explicit.

three.label: Three.js
three.description: Used when 3D helps explain or anchor the experience.

content.label: Content model
content.description: Projects and services are centralized so future admin editing is realistic.

backend.label: Backend later
backend.description: The ASP.NET backend stays parked until a real workflow needs it.

aboutMe.contactIntro: Direct links are the current contact flow while forms stay hidden.

lab.title: Component Lab
lab.subtitle: A compact surface for theme tokens, typography, and interface states used across the portfolio.
lab.sampleBody: This lab keeps visual decisions close to production components instead of showing detached mockups.
notes: Tokens are read from the active styled-components theme.
Controls stay intentionally small so layout density matches the rest of DevOS.
This can grow into a real design-system documentation surface later.
